name: Jump Switch Lunge
instructions: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite foot forward.
cues: Drive up through the front foot
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A plyometric lunge where you jump and switch legs in the air to train power and conditioning.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Skip if you have knee problems; use an alternating step lunge as a regression.
